column1: # Spec tests that flake, so `bun run test:neo-spec --ci` never judges them, in either direction, on
# any platform: the job summary shows each one's outcome on every run, and none is on an expected
# list. Edit this file by hand in a pull request; no command adds or removes an entry. Each entry
# says why the test flakes and where its fix is tracked. Take it off when the fix lands.

column4: A stale page error reaches a new listener: a waitForEvent('pageerror') round receives the previous round's thrown value (Expected "0", Received "undefined"). Fails about one run in ten on macOS, on main and on the commit before it; passes alone.
column5: Root-cause fix assigned by the claw-sdk lead on 2026-11-12 (the events wait path, js/events.ts).

column3: page screenshot animations › should not capture css animations in shadow DOM
column4: page.screenshot with animations disabled, of an infinite CSS animation inside a shadow root: on headless Linux Page.captureScreenshot sometimes never returns and the test times out at 30 s, also when run alone. Its siblings SS-052, SS-053, SS-057 and SS-059 time out on every run. Seen flaky on four branches on 2026-11-12.
column5: No owner yet: the headless-Linux screenshot hang in page-screenshot.spec.ts, the same cause as the listed SS-024, SS-027, SS-052, SS-053, SS-057, SS-059 and SS-065.
